tiny_two_units.derivation: One mill processes two 3-second units; the last unit then needs 2 seconds QC. [0,3)/[3,5) and [3,6)/[6,8) attain the bound. T=2*(8-6)=4; scalar=21*4+8.

priority_tradeoff.derivation: Zero tardiness requires short mill [0,2), short QC [2,3). Long mill then finishes no earlier than 5 and long QC no earlier than 15. Long-first can finish at 14 but delays the short order until 14.
